text: This staff report is about a matter which Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has assessed an appeal from the owner of 160B Cedric Avenue for front yard parking. Front yard parking at this location is not recommended because it does not meet the criteria of the City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 918 in that the Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where on-street permit parking is authorised on the same side of the street. Additionally, the Code does not permit the licensing of a front yard parking pad where the poll was negative. The owner will be given an opportunity to make a deputation before Community Council.

North York Community Council: 1. Granted the appeal and approved front yard parking at 160B Cedric Avenue, with the following conditions: a. that the parking area be a minimum of 2.2 metres in width and not exceed 2.4 metres and a minimum of 5.3 metres and not exceed 5.9 metres in length; b. that the applicant pay for the installation of the permanent ramp to service the parking space; c. that the applicant pay for the relocation of the raised traffic calming device; d. that the applicant disconnect any downspouts, if feasible, or seek an exemption from Toronto Water in accordance with the requirements in Chapter 681-11(S); e. that the applicant pay the enforcement fee of $738.94 (HST included) since the parking pad was constructed prior to the submission of the application and without authorization from the City; f. that the applicant provide the landscape features substantially in…
